# Protocol schemas

<!-- Generated by packages/protocol/scripts/generate.ts from packages/protocol/src. Do not edit. Run `bun run protocol:generate`. -->

Versioned contracts shared by TypeScript (`@ablationkit/protocol`) and Python (`ablationkit-protocol`).
Machine-readable JSON Schemas are in [`packages/protocol/schemas/`](../../packages/protocol/schemas/).
Conventions and the generation pipeline: ADR 0005.

## EventEnvelope (v1)

One event as emitted by a producer, before the coordinator journals it.

Schema: [`event-envelope.v1.schema.json`](../../packages/protocol/schemas/event-envelope.v1.schema.json)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | `1` | yes |  |
| `event_id` | `EventId` | yes | Globally unique event identifier chosen by the producer; the dedupe key at ingest. |
| `project_id` | `ProjectId` | yes | Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry. |
| `ablationkit_job_id` | `JobId` | no | AblationKit job identifier. |
| `attempt_id` | `AttemptId` | no | Identifier of one attempt of a job. |
| `producer_id` | `ProducerId` | yes | Identifier of the process or worker that produced an event. |
| `producer_seq` | `SequenceNumber` | yes | Per-producer sequence number; with producer_id it orders and dedupes events. |
| `ts` | `Timestamp` | yes | RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds. |
| `type` | `EventType` | yes | Dotted lowercase event type, for example `run.started` or `console.line`. |
| `payload` | object | yes | Typed payload for this event type; a JSON object. |

| `kind` | any JSON | yes | `attempt`: one execution attempt of a job. `manual`: created from the UI/CLI. `import`: a run that happened outside AblationKit, imported from its files (ADR 0043). |
| `project_id` | `ProjectId` | yes | Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry. |

| `experiment_id` | `MlflowExperimentId` | no | Set once MLflow acknowledges the experiment. |

| `job_id` | `JobId` | no | AblationKit job identifier. |
| `attempt_id` | `AttemptId` | no | Identifier of one attempt of a job. |
| `study_id` | `StudyId` | no | Study identifier (a planned comparison: baseline plus variants). |

| `last_error` | string | no | Last rejected or failed write, for display. |
| `created_at` | `Timestamp` | yes | RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds. |
| `updated_at` | `Timestamp` | yes | RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds. |
| `synced_at` | `Timestamp` | no | When the last queued write was acknowledged. |
| `logged_model_id` | string | no |  |
| `registered_model_name` | string | no |  |
| `registered_model_version` | string | no |  |
| `evaluation_id` | string | no |  |
| `trace_id` | string | no |  |
| `deployment_id` | string | no |  |
| `mlproject_entrypoint` | string | no |  |
| `import_source` | string | no | `import` runs: where the run's files were (a path in the checkout); one import per source. |

## TrackingOutboxRecord (v1)

One entry of the temporary durable tracking outbox. Replaying the journal gives the pending and failed writes; fully resolved segments are deleted.

Schema: [`tracking-outbox-record.v1.schema.json`](../../packages/protocol/schemas/tracking-outbox-record.v1.schema.json)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | `1` | yes |  |
| `seq` | `SequenceNumber` | yes | Non-negative sequence number. |
| `ts` | `Timestamp` | yes | RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds. |
| `type` | any JSON | yes | `enqueue` adds `op`; `ack` resolves it (with `result`); `fail` parks it after a rejection; `requeue` puts a failed op back. |
| `op_id` | string | yes |  |
| `op` | object | no | One queued MLflow write. |
| `result` | object | no |  |
| `error` | object | no | Why an MLflow write did not succeed. |

## BackupManifest (v1)

A coordinated snapshot of MLflow data (database and artifacts) and coordinator state.

Schema: [`backup-manifest.v1.schema.json`](../../packages/protocol/schemas/backup-manifest.v1.schema.json)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | `1` | yes |  |
| `backup_id` | string | yes |  |
| `created_at` | `Timestamp` | yes | RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds. |
| `reason` | any JSON | yes | `move`: taken by `coordinator move` with the coordinator stopped, before this home was retired. |
| `quiesce` | any JSON | no | How writes were held still: tracking delivery paused in a running coordinator, or the coordinator stopped (the runtime lock held by the backup). Absent in backups made before Stage 17 (tracking_paused). |
| `source` | object | no | The machine and runtime directory the backup was taken from. |
| `projects` | array of object | no | Registered projects and their checkout paths at backup time; restore remaps them (`--project ID=PATH`). |
| `mlflow_version` | string | no |  |
| `mlflow_database` | any JSON | yes | `vacuum_into`: SQLite-safe snapshot taken with `VACUUM INTO` (never a raw copy of the live file). `absent`: no MLflow database yet. |
| `outbox` | object | yes | Outbox state when the snapshot was taken. |
| `files` | array of object | yes |  |
| `excluded` | array of string | yes | What was deliberately left out, and why. |

## JobRecord (v1)

One logical job submission. Retries add attempts; each attempt has its own run.

Schema: [`job-record.v1.schema.json`](../../packages/protocol/schemas/job-record.v1.schema.json)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | `1` | yes |  |
| `job_id` | `JobId` | yes | AblationKit job identifier. |
| `project_id` | `ProjectId` | yes | Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry. |
| `command` | array of string | yes | argv, run from `cwd` inside the project checkout. |
| `cwd` | string | no | Working directory relative to the checkout. |
| `environment` | any JSON | yes | `uv`: run through `uv run --frozen --project <checkout>` (the project's own environment). `none`: run argv as given. |
| `env` | object | yes | Extra environment variables. Stored in plain text: never put secrets here. |
| `limits` | object | yes | CPU, memory, time and task limits for one attempt. |
| `artifact_paths` | array of string | yes | Globs relative to the checkout, collected as artifacts after the process exits (for scripts without the SDK). |
| `metrics_file` | string | no | File adapter for scripts without the SDK: a JSON-lines file (relative to the checkout) the collector tails; each object's numeric fields (nested ones flattened with `/`) become metrics at its step. |
| `metrics_format` | object | no | How the metrics-file adapter reads each line: nested objects are always flattened with `/`; these name the step and time keys, which are never metrics. |
| `input_paths` | array of string | no | Globs relative to the checkout, recorded as `inputs/<path>` artifacts as the job starts (configs the source commit does not hold, e.g. ignored ones). Jobs on this machine only. |
| `run_name` | string | no |  |
| `description` | string | no | What the run tests and why, in a sentence or two. Each attempt's run starts with it as its summary (ADR 0048). |
| `study_id` | `StudyId` | no | Study identifier (a planned comparison: baseline plus variants). |
| `variant_id` | `VariantId` | no | Variant identifier (one configuration or code change under test). |
| `task_id` | `TaskId` | no | AblationKit task identifier (UI- or agent-first task). |
| `agenda_item` | string | no | The item of the researcher's agenda this job serves (ADR 0058): `note:<id>` or `L<n>`. |
| `mlproject` | object | no | The `MLproject` entrypoint a job was launched from (spec §5.5 MLflow Projects). It runs with local environment semantics in the job runner. |
| `target_id` | `TargetId` | no | Remote compute target (ADR 0023). Absent: this machine. Each attempt runs from its own staged bundle. |
| `bundle_inputs` | array of object | no | Remote jobs: coordinator-staged directories copied into each attempt's bundle at `inputs/<name>` and checksummed with it (a remote evaluation's pinned model). The job finds them under `$ABLATIONKIT_BUNDLE_INPUTS`. |
| `submitted_by` | object | yes | Who submitted a job. |
| `compute_weight_hundredths` | integer | no | Agent jobs (ADR 0037): the weight of the job's target when it was submitted, in hundredths. Every attempt's wall time times this weight counts against the project's `compute.limit_hours`; changing the target's weight later does not change it. |
| `via_extension` | string | no | Submitted through this extension backend's broker (`compute.remote`, ADR 0024); only it may read or cancel the job there. |
| `container` | object | no | Set on jobs a contained agent session submits (ADR 0061): each local attempt runs in a job container of its own. |
| `state` | `AttemptState` | yes | State of the latest attempt. |
| `attempts` | array of `AttemptId` | yes | Attempt IDs, oldest first. |
| `created_at` | `Timestamp` | yes | RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds. |
| `updated_at` | `Timestamp` | yes | RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds. |

## AttemptRecord (v1)

| `job_id` | `JobId` | yes | AblationKit job identifier. |
| `project_id` | `ProjectId` | yes | Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry. |
| `number` | integer | yes |  |
| `state` | `AttemptState` | yes | Compute status of one attempt. `unknown`: the collector vanished without reporting an exit; nothing is rerun automatically. |

| `started_at` | `Timestamp` | no | RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds. |
| `ended_at` | `Timestamp` | no | RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds. |
| `cancel_requested_at` | `Timestamp` | no | RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds. |
| `supervisor` | object | yes |  |
| `collector` | object | yes | Last health report from the attempt's collector. |
| `token_id` | string | yes | Worker token for this attempt. |
| `pid` | integer | no |  |
| `exit_code` | integer | no |  |
| `signal` | string | no |  |
| `unit_result` | string | no | systemd `Result` of the scope. |
| `error` | string | no |  |
| `snapshot` | object | no | Provenance captured when the attempt started (spec §6). |
| `artifacts` | array of object | yes |  |
| `remote` | object | no | Remote execution, connectivity and sync status of one attempt. |

## ComputeTarget (v1)

A configured remote compute target. Credentials are referenced, never stored.

Schema: [`compute-target.v1.schema.json`](../../packages/protocol/schemas/compute-target.v1.schema.json)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | `1` | yes |  |
| `target_id` | `TargetId` | yes | Compute target identifier (lowercase slug). `local` is reserved for this machine. |
| `kind` | `TargetKind` | yes | `ssh`: a worker host reached over SSH (usually on the tailnet). `slurm`: a cluster login node reached over SSH; jobs go through `sbatch`. `runpod`: pods through the Runpod REST API. `colab`: Google Colab runtimes, unattended through Google's Colab CLI (`colab.mode: cli`) or as an exported notebook a person runs (`notebook`). |
| `label` | string | no |  |
| `ssh` | object | no | How the coordinator reaches a host. Uses the user's SSH keys and config. |
| `slurm` | object | no |  |
| `runpod` | object | no |  |
| `colab` | object | no |  |
| `work_dir` | string | no | Where bundles are unpacked on the worker. Default `~/.ablationkit-worker`. |
| `python` | string | no | Python 3.10+ on the worker. Default `python3`. |

## VaultNote (v1)

An atomic note of a project's vault (ADR 0049). `created` and `updated` are when the thing became known and when what the note says last changed; `edition` marks a notebook that reports one working session; `task_id` is the task it was written under.

Schema: [`vault-note.v1.schema.json`](../../packages/protocol/schemas/vault-note.v1.schema.json)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | `1` | yes |  |
| `note_id` | `VaultNoteId` | yes | A note's identifier, unique within a project: kebab-case words that say what the note is (`macro-tokenizer`, not `note-12`). It is what `[[id]]` links and `![[id]]` embeds name, so it does not change. |
| `project_id` | `ProjectId` | yes | Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry. |
| `type` | `VaultNoteType` | yes | What a note is. concept: a fundamental, independent of any experiment. method: how this project builds or does something. experiment: one study and its protocol. finding: what was observed, with its numbers and limits. claim: what is believed, with a standing. decision: a choice made and why. question: something not known yet. log: process worth keeping that is not knowledge. figure: a chart, table or visualisation drawn from the project's runs by code the note carries (ADR 0053). notebook: a compilation of embedded notes with connecting prose. |
| `title` | string | yes | A claim, finding or decision is titled with a sentence that states it; a concept or method with its name; a question with the question. |
| `gist` | string | yes | One sentence that says the thing itself (not a description of the note). The first of the three depths. |
| `summary` | string | no | Two to four sentences that continue from the gist without restating it. For a notebook: its opening paragraph, what it establishes and how it proceeds. Markdown with LaTeX, `[[id]]` links. |
| `full` | string | no | The rest, continuing from the summary without restating it. `![[id]]` alone on a line embeds another note at that point. For a notebook: the composition, connecting prose and embeds, optionally under `##` headings. |
| `standing` | `VaultStanding` | no | Where a claim, decision or question stands. claim: established, leaning, open or ruled_out. decision: in_force, proposed or superseded. question: open or answered. Other types carry none. |
| `key` | object | no | The one number or comparison that carries the note, and what it is. |
| `support` | string | no | Claims: how much evidence, plainly (runs, seeds, scale). |
| `would_change` | string | no | Claims: what result would move the standing. |
| `evidence` | array of object | no |  |
| `figure` | object | no | Figures: the code that draws the figure (ADR 0053). The gist says in words what it shows; the runs it draws from are its `evidence`. |
| `study` | string | no | Experiments: the study record whose variants this note describes. |
| `aliases` | array of string | no | Concepts and methods: other words the term goes by (an abbreviation, a plural), so a mention in another note's prose finds this note. |
| `bears_on` | array of `VaultNoteId` | no | Questions: the claims an answer would move. |
| `cites` | array of object | no | The prior work the note rests on, from the project's library, each with its role. Shown with the note; exported as citations. |
| `sources` | array of string | yes | Where the note was distilled from, as `kind:id` (`task:…`, `run:…`, `study:…`, a research record kind) or `repo:<path>` for a file in the project's repository. Provenance, shown last. |
| `task_id` | `TaskId` | no | AblationKit task identifier (UI- or agent-first task). |
| `edition` | `VaultDate` | no | A calendar date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `created` | `VaultDate` | yes | A calendar date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `updated` | `VaultDate` | yes | A calendar date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `created_at` | `Timestamp` | yes | RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds. |
| `updated_at` | `Timestamp` | yes | RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds. |
| `created_by` | object | yes | Who made a change: a human session, an agent token or the system. Work under a task links the task (`task:ID`). |
| `updated_by` | object | yes | Who made a change: a human session, an agent token or the system. Work under a task links the task (`task:ID`). |
| `revision` | integer | yes |  |
| `archived_at` | `Timestamp` | no | RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds. |

## ResearchDirection (v1)

The researcher's direction to the agents working on a project (ADR 0057), anchored where they read, with its thread and its deliveries. Written by the researcher only; agents respond.

| `build_id` | `ExtensionBuildId` | yes | Content-derived build ID, `eb-<16 hex>`: the same source, lockfile and capabilities give the same build. |

## SourceBuildRecord (v1)

A reviewable modified build of AblationKit itself (Level 2, spec §8.5): commit, branch, changes against the base, the checks run and their results. Activation is separate and only changes the next start.

Schema: [`source-build-record.v1.schema.json`](../../packages/protocol/schemas/source-build-record.v1.schema.json)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `build_id` | `SourceBuildId` | yes | A modified AblationKit build, `b-<commit12>-<n>`. |
| `commit` | string | yes |  |
| `branch` | string | no |  |
| `base_ref` | string | no |  |
| `base_commit` | string | no |  |
| `changed_files` | array of string | yes | Files changed against the base, for review. |
| `diffstat` | string | no |  |
| `source_dir` | string | yes |  |
| `checks` | array of object | yes |  |
| `status` | any JSON | yes | `ready`: built and every check passed (or was explicitly skipped). |
| `error` | string | no |  |

| `CollectorHealth` | object |  | Last health report from the attempt's collector. |
| `ComputeLimit` | object |  |  |
| `ComputeLimitRefusals` | object |  | Agent submissions refused since the last admitted one under this policy revision: one notification per burst. |
| `ConsoleStream` | undefined |  | `log`: a Python logging record from the SDK handler. `system`: a note from AblationKit itself. |
| `ContainerAgentLimits` | object |  | The agent container's own limits (kernel-enforced by its cgroup). It has no GPU. |

| `ContainerSnapshot` | object |  | The checkout's commit and uncommitted files, and the project environment's packages, at a point of the session. |
| `ContainerSupervisor` | object |  | Where the terminal the container is attached to lives: a tmux server in a transient systemd unit, or a detached process. |

| `DirectionStatus` | undefined |  | open: waiting for an agent. acknowledged: an agent said what it will do. answered or declined: an agent answered (with what it changed) or declined (with its reason); waiting for the researcher, who closes it or reopens it (back to open). withdrawn: the researcher took it back. A rule is open until a session acknowledges it and stays in force (open or acknowledged) until withdrawn. |

| `VaultLedger` | object |  |  |
| `VaultNoteId` | string | `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,95}$` | A note's identifier, unique within a project: kebab-case words that say what the note is (`macro-tokenizer`, not `note-12`). It is what `[[id]]` links and `![[id]]` embeds name, so it does not change. |
| `VaultNoteType` | undefined |  | What a note is. concept: a fundamental, independent of any experiment. method: how this project builds or does something. experiment: one study and its protocol. finding: what was observed, with its numbers and limits. claim: what is believed, with a standing. decision: a choice made and why. question: something not known yet. log: process worth keeping that is not knowledge. figure: a chart, table or visualisation drawn from the project's runs by code the note carries (ADR 0053). notebook: a compilation of embedded notes with connecting prose. |
| `VaultStanding` | undefined |  | Where a claim, decision or question stands. claim: established, leaning, open or ruled_out. decision: in_force, proposed or superseded. question: open or answered. Other types carry none. |
| `VaultWorkId` | string | `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$` | A work's identifier in the project's library, also its citation key: kebab-case, the first author's family name, the year and a word of the title (`vaswani-2017-attention`), or the project and owner for code (`karpathy-nanogpt`). It does not change. |
| `VaultWorkKind` | undefined |  | What a work is. paper: published in a journal or conference (`venue`). preprint: arXiv and the like. book, thesis, report (a technical report). repo: a code repository. software: a released package. dataset, model: a published dataset or model card. docs: documentation. article: a blog post or essay. thread: an issue, pull request, forum or Q&A thread. talk: a talk or video. |
| `VaultWorkReading` | undefined |  | How closely the work was read: unread (found, not read yet), abstract (the abstract or README only), skimmed, read (the parts that matter, closely). Said plainly so a reader knows how much a citation rests on. |
| `WorkerArtifactStore` | object |  | Presigned PUT URLs for an S3-compatible store: the worker uploads a large artifact there without the coordinator, then reports a receipt naming the slot; the coordinator pulls, verifies the SHA-256, stores it through MLflow and deletes the object (ADR 0023 decision 24). |
| `WorkerNtfy` | object |  |  |
| `WorkerPhase` | undefined |  | `lost`: the worker restarted and the job's process was gone without an exit record (a reboot, a requeue). It is never rerun. |
| `WorkerSpoolReport` | object |  |  |
